meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 9 — Defence and security densification: military expenditure, national defence policy framing, and related security strategy.

candidates.title: Defence / military expenditure statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from official budget and international compilations (SIPRI-aligned)
candidates.description: Estimates and reported figures for Vietnam’s military expenditure. Recent levels are commonly placed around USD 10 billion and in the low-to-mid 2 % of GDP range. Provides the resource base for force modernisation and self-defence capacity.

candidates.title: National defence policy framing
candidates.publisher: Ministry of National Defence / Party-State documents
candidates.description: Official national defence policy emphasising peace, self-defence, non-use of force, peaceful settlement of disputes, and gradual modernisation of the Vietnam People’s Army sufficient for self-defence. Continuously cited in security and foreign-policy analysis.
candidates.notes: Core policy-frame node for Vietnamese defence posture.

candidates.title: National security strategy framing
candidates.description: High-level national security strategy documents and resolutions that set priorities for internal stability, external defence, and the integration of security with socio-economic development.
referenced_by: Internal security and social stability analysis
candidates.notes: Strategic densification above day-to-day defence policy.

candidates.title: Maritime security and East Sea (South China Sea) framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from defence, foreign-policy and partnership sources
candidates.description: Policy and strategic framing of Vietnam’s maritime security interests, including sovereignty claims and the consistent preference for peaceful negotiation under international law (UNCLOS). Closely linked to the multi-vector external posture.
referenced_by: China partnership and multi-vector strategy nodes
candidates.notes: Maritime-security densification of the defence cluster.

candidates.title: Vietnam defence–security densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from MOD, fiscal and strategy sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding defence/military expenditure, national defence policy framing, national security strategy framing, and maritime security / East Sea framing into a coherent defence and security layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Fiscal, partnership and multi-vector series from earlier batches
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the defence densification pass.
